## Change

Describe the behavior you changed and link the related issue.

## Check

- [ ] I ran `npm run build` on Windows.
- [ ] I checked the light and dark themes if I changed the interface.
- [ ] I checked install and removal through Windows if I changed font discovery.
- [ ] I added screenshots for a visible change.
- [ ] I kept font files, backups, and personal data out of the commit.
